articles.title: Binance, Polymarket seek Polygon hard fork to recover $6.8M in stolen crypto
articles.snippet: Polygon block producers have already frozen the stolen tokens, but a proposed hard fork would allow the funds to be recovered and returned to their owners.

articles.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
articles.snippet: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

articles.title: Bitcoin Shrugs Off Midterms as Experts Say Democratic Sweep Was 'Priced In'
articles.snippet: Experts say the Democratic sweep was largely priced in, but it makes the road ahead harder for crypto policy.

articles.title: Midterms Blue Wave Makes $917K for One Polymarket Trader, If Alaska Doesn’t Flip
articles.snippet: A Polymarket trader topped the prediction market’s leaderboard after Democrats swept the US midterms, but Alaska could still flip it.
